steps: Clean loose debris from the hole.
Apply lightweight spackle with a putty knife, slightly overfilling.
Let dry fully (check product time), then sand flush with fine-grit sandpaper.
Wipe away dust with a damp cloth.
Prime and paint to match the surrounding wall.

materials.name: DAP Alex Plus 16 oz. spackling paste
3M Pro Grade Precision 80/120/220 grit sandpaper kit
